title: Wind Power Just Passed Hydro In America
source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) Electric Power Annual net generation by energy source: wind ~95 (2010), ~168 (2013), ~227 (2016), ~300 (2019), ~380 (2021), ~425 (2023), ~430 (2024) billion kWh; conventional hydroelectric ~260 (2010), ~269 (2013), ~267 (2016), ~274 (2019), ~252 (2021), ~239 (2023), ~241 (2024) billion kWh. EIA reported wind generation first exceeded hydroelectric generation on an annual basis in 2019.
